name: io.github.usekaval/kaval
title: Kaval
description: Verify the facts an agent's action depends on before it acts — ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK.

environmentVariables.name: KAVAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bring-your-own Kaval bearer key (kv_live_…). Create one at https://usekaval.com.

environmentVariables.name: KAVAL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Point at a self-hosted or staging Kaval API instead of the hosted one. Defaults to https://api.usekaval.com.
